usage: The word 兄弟 is used to refer to brothers or male siblings in Cantonese.
It can also be used metaphorically to mean close male friends who are like brothers.
When talking about your siblings, 兄弟 generally refers to male siblings only, not sisters.
In a sentence, 兄弟 can appear as the subject or object, and it is usually plural unless specified otherwise.
You can combine 兄弟 with numbers to specify how many brothers you have, e.g., 三兄弟 (three brothers).
